tips.label: 關係副詞
tips.text: 原因用 why、時間用 when、地點用 where；後面接主詞與動詞。

tips.label: 評論人的行為
tips.text: It + be + 形容詞 + of + 人 + to + 原形動詞。of 後的代名詞用受格。

notes.title: 關係副詞 why：原因
notes.description: why 引導關係子句，修飾表示原因的 reason，說明「……的原因」。
examples: That is the reason why he left in a hurry.（那就是他匆忙離開的原因。）

notes.title: 關係副詞 when：時間
notes.rule: 時間名詞 + when + S + V
notes.description: when 修飾 day、year、time、season 等時間名詞，在子句中表示時間。
examples: I remember the day when we met.（我記得我們見面的那一天。）

notes.title: 關係副詞 where：地點
notes.rule: 地點名詞 + where + S + V
notes.description: where 修飾 place、school、town 等地點名詞，在子句中表示地點。不能只看到時間或地點名詞就選 when 或 where，還要看子句缺什麼：若缺主詞或受詞，應考慮關係代名詞 that 或 which。
examples: This is the town where the expert lives.（這是那位專家居住的城鎮。）
This is the town that we visited.（這是我們參觀過的城鎮；visited 缺受詞，因此用 that。）

notes.title: It ... of 人 to V：評論人的行為
notes.rule: It + be + Adj + of + 人 + to V
notes.description: It 是虛主詞，to V 說明被評論的行為。常見形容詞有 kind、nice、polite、rude、honest、careless、foolish、smart。of 後用受格 me、him、her、us、them；to 後用原形動詞。be 依情境可用 is 或 was。
examples: It was polite of Ryan to open the door for me.（Ryan 幫我開門，真有禮貌。）
It was kind of the resident to help us.（那位居民幫助我們，真是好心。）

notes.title: 分清 of 和 for
notes.rule: 評論人的行為用 of；描述事情的難易等性質常用 for
notes.description: 本課重點是 of 人。kind、polite、rude 等用來評論人的行為；easy、difficult、important 等若描述事情對某人而言的性質，通常用 for 人。
examples: It was kind of him to help me.（他幫我，真是好心。）
It is easy for him to read this book.（讀這本書對他來說很容易。）

quiz.question: The bakery ___ my sister works sells fresh bread.
quiz.hint: bakery 是地點，後面的 my sister works 已有主詞與動詞，需用 where 表示工作的地方。

quiz.question: October is the month ___ our school holds its sports day.
quiz.hint: month 表示時間，子句說明在該月舉辦活動，用 when。

quiz.question: Can you explain the reason ___ you avoided that street?
quiz.hint: reason 表示原因，後面的子句完整，用 why 引出原因。

quiz.question: It was honest ___ Leo to tell us about the broken cup.
quiz.hint: honest 評論 Leo 說實話的行為，使用 It was honest of 人 to V。

quiz.question: It was nice of ___ to carry my heavy bag.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，後面的人稱代名詞用受格 her。

quiz.question: It was rude of Max ___ during the speech.
quiz.hint: It was rude of 人後接 to 加原形動詞，說明被評論的行為。

quiz.question: We found a quiet corner ___ the baby could sleep peacefully.
quiz.hint: 子句已有主詞與動詞，corner 表示睡覺的地點，用 where。

quiz.question: Do you remember the evening ___ the lights went out?
quiz.hint: evening 是時間，the lights went out 是完整子句，用 when。

quiz.question: The bus broke down. That is the reason ___ I arrived late.
quiz.hint: 前句說明遲到原因；the reason 後用 why 連接完整子句。

quiz.question: It was careless ___ me to leave the key outside.
quiz.hint: careless 評論我把鑰匙留在外面的行為，介系詞用 of。

quiz.question: It was polite of ___ to wait outside the office.
quiz.hint: of 後用受格 them，不能用主格或所有格。

quiz.question: It was smart of Judy to ___ a map before the trip.
quiz.hint: 此句型中的 to 是不定詞符號，後面接原形動詞 check。

quiz.question: That is the village ___ my grandparents grow rice.
quiz.hint: grow rice 已有受詞；空格要表示在該村莊，故用 where。

quiz.question: I miss the days ___ we played by the river.
quiz.hint: days 是時間，子句說明在那些日子做的事，用 when。

quiz.question: Nobody knows the reason ___ the shop closed so early.
quiz.hint: reason 後接完整子句，表示提早關店的原因，用 why。

quiz.question: It was kind ___ the resident to lend us an umbrella.
quiz.hint: kind 評論居民借傘給我們的行為，用 of 人。

quiz.question: It was foolish of ___ to believe that strange story.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 of 後表示被評論的人，代名詞應用受格 him。

quiz.question: It was nice of Mia ___ the usage of this word.
quiz.hint: to explain 是不定詞，說明 Mia 做了什麼值得稱讚的事。

quiz.question: The library ___ I study after school closes at six.
quiz.hint: library 表地點，I study after school 不缺主詞或受詞，用 where。

quiz.question: There was a time ___ we had no phones.
quiz.hint: time 表示時期，完整子句前用關係副詞 when。

quiz.question: Please tell me the reason ___ you denied taking the book.
quiz.hint: the reason 後以 why 引導子句，說明否認拿書的原因。

quiz.question: It was rude ___ the boys to laugh at the new student.
quiz.hint: rude 評論男孩們的行為，使用 of 人 to V。

quiz.question: It was kind of ___ to show the visitors around.
quiz.hint: of 後接人稱代名詞受格 us。

quiz.question: It was honest of Nina to ___ that she was wrong.
quiz.hint: to 後要接原形動詞 say，構成表示行為的不定詞。

quiz.question: The park ___ we bumped into our teacher has a lake.
quiz.hint: we bumped into our teacher 結構完整，空格表示相遇的地方，用 where。

quiz.question: Friday was the day ___ the expert came to our class.
quiz.hint: day 表示時間；子句已有完整主詞、動詞與其他成分，用 when。

quiz.question: Her phone had no power. That was the reason ___ she did not call.
quiz.hint: 前句提供未打電話的原因，the reason 後用 why。

quiz.question: It was polite ___ the girl to thank the driver.
quiz.hint: polite 評論女孩向司機道謝的行為，因此用 of。

quiz.question: It was careless of ___ to lose the tickets.
quiz.hint: of 是介系詞，第一人稱單數用受格 me。

quiz.question: It was smart of the children ___ their money for books.
quiz.hint: It was smart of 人後接不定詞 to save，表示被評論的行為。

quiz.question: This is the room ___ we keep the ancient maps.
quiz.hint: keep 已有受詞 the ancient maps，room 表存放地點，用 where。

quiz.question: Summer is the season ___ many residents swim in this lake.
quiz.hint: season 是時間名詞，用 when 引導完整子句。

quiz.question: I finally understood the reason ___ Dad looked worried.
quiz.hint: looked worried 已構成完整述語；空格修飾 reason，用 why。

quiz.question: It was nice ___ our neighbor to bring us plenty of food.
quiz.hint: nice 在此評論鄰居送食物的行為，需用 of 人。

quiz.question: It was rude of ___ to push past the old man.
quiz.hint: of 後要使用受格 him，指出行為受到評論的人。

quiz.question: It was kind of the expert to ___ my question.
quiz.hint: 不定詞 to 後用原形 answer，不能用第三人稱或過去式。

quiz.question: The town ___ we visited last spring is famous for tea.
quiz.hint: visited 缺少受詞，空格代替 town 作受詞，所以用關係代名詞 which。

quiz.question: I still remember the day ___ changed my life.
quiz.hint: changed 前缺主詞，應用 which 代替 the day；when 不能作主詞。

quiz.question: The school ___ my mother teaches has a small garden.
quiz.hint: my mother teaches 已能構成完整子句，空格表示任教的地點，用 where。

quiz.question: It is difficult ___ young children to read this formal letter.
quiz.hint: difficult 描述讀信這件事的難度，不評論人的品格，使用 for 人。

quiz.question: It was foolish of ___ to go out without a coat.
quiz.hint: of 後接受格 them，表示做出這個行為的人。

quiz.question: It was polite of Sam ___ before entering the room.
quiz.hint: 此句型以 to 加原形動詞說明行為，所以用 to knock。

quiz.question: The museum ___ has ancient cups is near the station.
quiz.hint: has 前缺少主詞，須用 which 代替 museum；不是用表示地點的 where。

quiz.question: Winter was the season ___ we first saw snow.
quiz.hint: season 表時間；we first saw snow 已完整，用 when。

quiz.question: The road was closed. That is the reason ___ we took a different bus.
quiz.hint: the reason 指改搭其他公車的原因，後面用 why 接完整子句。

quiz.question: It is easy ___ Kelly to remember new expressions.
quiz.hint: easy 描述記住用語這件事對 Kelly 的難易，使用 for 人。

quiz.question: It was honest of ___ to return the money.
quiz.hint: 介系詞 of 後需用人稱代名詞的受格 her。

quiz.question: It was nice of Eric to ___ out the mistake quietly.
quiz.hint: 不定詞 to 後接原形動詞 point；本題考動詞形式。

quiz.question: The evening ___ we spent together was wonderful.
quiz.hint: spent 缺受詞，which 代替 the evening 作受詞；when 不能補受詞。

quiz.question: It was kind ___ the students to help clean the old house.
quiz.hint: kind 評論學生幫忙打掃的行為，搭配 of 人 to V。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 這是爸爸看報紙的咖啡館。

grammar.sentence: It was kind of Sue to share her lunch.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Sue 分享午餐，真是好心。

grammar.sentence: I remember the night when our dog came home.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我記得我們的狗回家的那個夜晚。

grammar.sentence: Tell me the reason why you changed your plan.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 告訴我你改變計畫的原因。

grammar.sentence: It was careless of Ben to forget his wallet.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Ben 忘了帶錢包，真是粗心。

grammar.sentence: We visited the farm where my uncle raises chickens.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們參觀了我叔叔養雞的農場。

grammar.sentence: Autumn is the season when these leaves turn red.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 秋天是這些葉子變紅的季節。

grammar.sentence: It was honest of Lily to admit her mistake.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Lily 承認錯誤，真是誠實。

grammar.sentence: I know the reason why the baby is crying.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我知道寶寶哭泣的原因。

grammar.sentence: This is the bridge where we took that photo.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這是我們拍那張照片的橋。

grammar.sentence: It was rude of him to interrupt the teacher.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他打斷老師的話，真是沒禮貌。

grammar.sentence: Monday was the day when our new teacher arrived.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 星期一是我們新老師到來的日子。

grammar.sentence: Do you know the reason why the river smells bad?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道河水發臭的原因嗎？

grammar.sentence: It was polite of Grace to knock before entering.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Grace 進門前先敲門，真有禮貌。

grammar.sentence: That is the shop where I bought my glasses.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那是我買眼鏡的商店。

grammar.sentence: I remember the year when our family moved here.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我記得我們家搬來這裡的那一年。

grammar.sentence: It was foolish of us to ignore the warning.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們忽視警告，真是愚蠢。

grammar.sentence: She explained the reason why she needed more time.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她解釋了她需要更多時間的原因。

grammar.sentence: We found a beach where the children could play.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們找到一處孩子們可以玩耍的海灘。

grammar.sentence: It was smart of him to bring extra water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他多帶一些水，真是聰明。

grammar.sentence: Spring is the season when we plant these flowers.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 春天是我們種這些花的季節。

grammar.sentence: I discovered the reason why my computer stopped working.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我發現了電腦停止運作的原因。

grammar.sentence: It was nice of them to visit our grandmother.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們來探望我們的祖母，真是貼心。

grammar.sentence: This is the station where I lost my umbrella.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這是我弄丟雨傘的車站。

grammar.sentence: We remember the morning when the snow finally stopped.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們記得雪終於停下來的那個早晨。

grammar.sentence: It was kind of you to explain the rules.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你解釋規則，真是好心。

grammar.sentence: The reason why Paul missed dinner is still unclear.
grammar.sentence_chinese: Paul 錯過晚餐的原因仍不清楚。

grammar.sentence: That is the garden where Grandma grows tomatoes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那是奶奶種番茄的花園。

grammar.sentence: It was careless of her to break the plate.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她打破盤子，真是粗心。

grammar.sentence: June was the month when my little sister was born.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 六月是我妹妹出生的月份。
